# Scribbr

> > Scribbr provides comprehensive AI-powered writing tools and academic resources through QuillBot, offering paraphrasing, grammar checking, plagiarism detection, and citation assistance.

Scribbr operates QuillBot, a complete AI writing suite designed for students, academics, and professionals. The platform combines advanced AI writing tools with educational resources to improve writing quality, ensure academic integrity, and streamline the writing process.
